content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked significant information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new HomePod mini, a security camera, a new Siri Remote to pair with the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the long-awaited HomePad device.

After digging deeper into the code, it seems there are more important clues about the design of the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget found that while the HomePad will likely run some variant of tvOS, it may operate more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also revealed a rather nice privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects your iPhone nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions—one with a speaker base similar to the HomePod, and another designed for wall mounting.

Besides the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, several unidentified devices were also referenced. Personally, I'm really hoping one of them turns out to be a smart doorbell. Which Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
